name: jakarta-ee-tools
author: Moataz Aldawood and his friend Google Gemini ;)
description: Advanced Jakarta Faces (JSF) tools: immediate quote auto-complete & smart EL snippets, Lombok annotation support (@Data, @Getter), incremental bean caching, EL semantic validation, component linking (for <-> id), deep nested Java EL resolution, custom composite component intelligence, and hover documentation. GitHub: https://github.com/Moataz-Aldawood/jakarta-faces-tools

configuration.title: Jakarta Faces Tools: EL Autocomplete [Beta Feature]

jakartaFacesTools.enableELAutocomplete.description: [Beta Feature] Enable intelligent auto-complete for Java Managed Beans and properties inside Expression Language (EL) #{...} expressions.

jakartaFacesTools.enableELDiagnostics.description: Enable real-time semantic diagnostics (warnings) for unknown Java Managed Beans and mistyped property names inside #{...} EL expressions.

jakartaFacesTools.enableIncrementalCache.description: Enable real-time Java file watching (**/*.java) and incremental cache updates when Managed Bean files are saved. Disable this in very large repositories or network drives if file watching causes performance issues.

jakartaFacesTools.showRebuildCacheButton.description: [Beta Feature] Show the 'Rebuild JSF Cache' button in the VS Code Status Bar. Expression Language (EL) Autocomplete caches your Java Managed Beans in memory for fast performance; use this button to force a fresh scan of your project if beans change outside of normal edits.

jakartaFacesTools.rebuildCacheButtonPosi.description: [Beta Feature] Choose the position ('Right' or 'Left') of the 'Rebuild JSF Cache' button in the VS Code Status Bar when Expression Language (EL) Autocomplete is enabled.

jakartaFacesTools.ELHighlighting.enable.description: Enable highlighting for Expression Language (EL) #{...} expressions.

jakartaFacesTools.ELHighlighting.backgro.description: Background color for Expression Language (EL) #{...} expressions. Supports CSS colors (e.g. rgba, hex).

jakartaFacesTools.ELHighlighting.color.description: Text color for Expression Language (EL) #{...} expressions (leave empty to use theme default).

jakartaFacesTools.ELHighlighting.borderR.description: Border radius for Expression Language (EL) #{...} expressions.

configuration.title: Jakarta Faces Tools: Documentation & Hover Cards

jakartaFacesTools.enableHoverCards.description: Enable rich documentation hover cards when hovering over JSF tags, attributes, namespaces, and component IDs.

commands.title: Rebuild JSF Cache (EL Autocomplete Beta Feature)

scripts.test: npm run compile && node testElDiagnostics.js && node testIncrementalCache.js && node testLombokSupport.js && node testImmediateAutocomplete.js
